scope: 60 repeated idle sync calls in a headless browser using production panel modules and an offline document fixture. No real PDF rendering or live Zotero interaction.

checks.name: before keeps the panel beside the document
after keeps the panel beside the document
container replacement is repaired without a periodic tick
native style reset is repaired without a periodic tick
a narrow reader folds the panel and preserves document space
restoring the window width restores the expanded panel
unchanged sync does not measure geometry
unchanged sync does not write styles
unchanged sync does not write diagnostics
no external requests or browser script errors
